title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Elmo?
description:
Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Elmo from Sesame Street, through Franco, the King of Spain and a first lady.

Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco → Juan Carlos I → Laura Bush → Elmo

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco: In 1940, Hitler met Spain's dictator Franco at a train station on the French border.
   Photo, PD-US: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Meeting_at_Hendaye_(en.wiki).jpg
2. Francisco Franco → King Juan Carlos: In 1969, Franco stood beside young Prince Juan Carlos, the man he chose to rule after him.
   Photo by Anefo, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:In_Madrid_is_herdacht_dat_Franco_30_jaar_geleden_de_burgeroorlog_(_1936_1939_)_w,_Bestanddeelnr_922-4913_(cropped).jpg
3. King Juan Carlos → Laura Bush: In 2001, King Juan Carlos welcomed George and Laura Bush to his palace in Madrid.
   Photo by Paul Morse, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sofia,_Laura_Bush,_George_W._Bush_and_Juan_Carlos.jpg
4. Laura Bush → Elmo: And in 2007, Laura Bush posed with Elmo at a Sesame Street benefit dinner.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mrs._Laura_Bush_and_daughters_pose_for_a_photo_with_Sesame_Street_character_Elmo.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #elmo #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
